spec.title: ZAP strategic map: semantic projections and descriptive assessments

status.comment: Initial projection-stage contract. Canonical milestone planning is an additive extension specified by ZAP-MILESTONES; the projection APIs themselves create no achievement authority. Existing authority and execution contracts remain in force.

p.MAP-PROJECTION: The initial strategic map is a read-only projection of an explicitly selected StrategicPlanRecord and its referenced current records at one query snapshot. No global current strategy is guessed. Candidate or superseded source states remain explicit. Missing materialized Work records can be represented by their strategic-node title, obligations, dependencies and refinement trigger, with missing live state named. Reading a map does not materialize work, activate authority, change scheduling or accept an outcome.

p.MAP-IDENTITY: Map objects retain underlying stable identities. Existing viewer objects, strategy revisions and execution resource references are distinct tagged reference kinds. Name, layout, page position and visual grouping do not create identity. Phase, Workstream, Group, Gate, Horizon and other WorkKind categories remain distinguishable; a milestone or landmark facet is an explicit projection of those categories, never a new completion predicate.

p.MAP-BOUNDS: Overview and relationship results have explicit limits, examined/emitted counts, missing data and continuation. Cursors bind store, base, query epoch, snapshot revision, selected strategy identity/revision/semantic digest and normalized request semantics. Wrong-source, foreign, stale and incompatible cursors refuse. Filtering can produce an empty page with continuation. Exact source-plan decoding and validation costs remain distinct from emitted membership counts; pagination does not claim constant cost for decoding a whole existing plan record. Required complete closures that exceed their operation budget refuse rather than reporting absence or completeness.

p.MAP-CARDS: A bounded object card carries identity, semantic type, canonical name, description or explicit missing-description state, purpose/result where available, source state and reason, acceptance meaning, blockers where established, typed relationships, source/evidence references and observation revision. A live Work contract is distinct from strategic-node description. No model call occurs on a card read. Optional display labels or explanations never replace the canonical goal or acceptance contract; absent or stale enrichment stays explicit. Existing exact viewer records and indexed joins are reused without changing their wire shape.

p.MAP-RELATIONSHIPS: Relationships preserve their source meaning: containment, work prerequisite, contract/obligation contribution and ownership role, acceptance duty, support, verification, derivation, affectedness, consumption, resource use and alternatives are distinct. IDs include the relation kind and any role/source identity needed to distinguish parallel meanings between the same endpoints. Work.depends_on must not be renamed to a planning-only or acceptance-only edge without its actual contract. The development pilot's depends_on and acceptance_depends_on remain separate edge kinds.

p.MAP-RESOURCES: Information opportunities project existing questions, sources, facts, evidence, cost unknowns and unresolved horizons. They are distinct from execution resources and capacity. An execution resource referenced by a contract does not acquire known capacity, availability or a richer description merely by being referenced. Bounded forward references are supported; a missing reverse index is not replaced with an unbounded family scan. Optional opportunities do not become runnable or completion-blocking merely by appearing on a map.

p.MAP-WORK-ASSESSMENT: A separate revisioned map-work assessment record may add a display label/explanation, remaining effort/time ranges, structural complexity, executor-relative difficulty, uncertainty and evidence to an existing materialized WorkId. Its data-proposal command is descriptive only: it changes no Work, contract, charter, approval, completion, resource allocation or dispatch state. Exact record CAS and command retry remain enforced. The initial assessment scope is existing Work records, including container/gate work; other object kinds expose existing information or explicit unassessed/reference-only state. No generic semantic conclusion is parsed into a numeric grade.

p.MAP-ASSESSMENT-BASIS: Assessment ingress checks a reproducible current source fingerprint of the Work and its applicable active contract data. A stale supplied source basis refuses. The assessment's own record and unrelated store commits are excluded from that fingerprint. Reads classify recorded metadata as current, stale or unavailable against the same algorithm. Stale descriptive data remains inspectable with provenance but cannot silently become a current estimate or authoritative task text. Active-contract selection reuses the existing complete indexed policy; no arbitrary first contract is chosen.

p.MAP-ASSESSMENT-DIMENSIONS: Remaining agent effort, elapsed duration, passive wait, structural complexity, difficulty and uncertainty are separate fields. Complexity and difficulty use independently explained low/medium/high grades with unassessed distinct from low. Assessed difficulty states executor/knowledge assumptions. Unknowns and confidence/precision are explicit; no invented probability or consequence-as-difficulty mapping is permitted. Ranges validate their bounds after deserialization; unknown upper bounds remain unknown. Assessment evidence is declared descriptive evidence and does not become acceptance or observed host capability.

p.MAP-EFFORT-SCOPE: Existing economics forecasts retain their change/assessment scope, baseline, team assumptions, evidence and relevant basis. They are not automatically mapped to arbitrary Work or routes. A supplied work estimate states its source and assumptions; no cost-prose parsing occurs. Current typed descriptive assessments may inform human views, while algorithmic routing and admission remain governed by their existing validated inputs.

p.MAP-ROUTE: A route view validates an explicit selection of distinct source-plan WorkIds and their relevant prerequisite closure under a finite budget. It preserves edge kinds, checks cycles/dangling dependencies and reports omitted prerequisites and unresolved blockers. Repeated IDs never multiply cost. Agent effort aggregates only comparable current estimates and counts shared work once. Known subtotals are distinct from a complete estimate; missing or stale estimates cannot become zero. Elapsed results are supplied estimates or explicitly labeled precedence-only lower bounds under stated assumptions, never a claim to a resource-feasible schedule or a naive sum of parallel durations. A route or map distance does not authorize execution.

p.MAP-VISUAL-INDEPENDENCE: The data model contains semantic object/relation kinds and inspectable measures, not terrain, icons, colors or pixel distances. A later client may map those meanings to towns, roads, forests or fog. Geometry cannot replace authoritative units/ranges. Display-only enrichment is optional and cannot block algorithm work.

p.MAP-PUBLIC-SURFACE: Registered typed domain queries expose overview, exact cards and route/relationship meaning through the existing machine Query request, authenticated HTTP query path and CLI read entrypoint. Query IDs appear through the actual registry. A new generic transport, runtime frontier replacement or model invocation is not required. Public types have real usage documentation and meaningful source/store/transport evidence.

p.MAP-PILOT: A read-only projection of the completed development campaign preserves all21identities,49planning dependencies and9distinct acceptance dependencies. Its six outcome groups are a presentation candidate; they create no whole-group execution barriers. It is not a canonical Work store or an authorization to import, migrate or execute NEXT. Independent actual-service fixtures verify the product query and assessment paths.

p.MAP-COMPATIBILITY: Version1.1 development preserves released1.0 source and tag. Existing records, commands, queries, logical history and runtime admission keep their current semantics. New descriptive records and queries are explicitly registered; no historical byte rewriting, baseline widening, gate exemption or silent schema substitution is allowed. The first implementation has no new canonical milestone acceptance authority, graphical client or live campaign migration.
